trades.name: Reclaim and hold of 6464-6466
trades.quote: I’ll long a reclaim and hold of 6464-6466, cautious of a failed reclaim. Given I have moderate (but not high) confidence of seeing 75-77 and that’s only 10 handles . . . I’m not particularly enthused about that trade. I’ll still consider it as a B- setup because of the possibility that today was just a hangover day and if buyers show up tomorrow to reject the spike, it might be just what is needed to break today’s range to the upside

trades.name: Failed reclaim of 6464-6466
trades.quote: I’ll short a failed reclaim of 6464-6466 but would be quite cautious in doing so given today’s sellers weren’t willing to initiate at the lows. This is somewhat lower probability but because of the potential to see a liquidation break below today’s low, I’ll also rate it a B-.

trades.name: Failure in 6475-6477
trades.quote: I’m open to shorting a failure in the 6475-6477 range, looking for 6464-6466. I can’t rate this higher than a C+/B- as it would imply at least an initial rejection of today’s spike down. If it happens overnight or very early during RTH I am more willing to try it.

trades.name: Long 6431-6435 area / quick LBAF
trades.quote: I am still open to longs in the 6431-6435 area or on a quick LBAF from the weekly plan. Following a liquidation break I tend to like this the most but it would still represent some significant weakness, so I’ll rate it a B/B-.

trades.name: Firm base above 23518-23532
trades.quote: I’ll look for longs if a firm base is built above 518-532. B/B+

trades.name: Front-run reclaim of 23518-23532 from 23485-23499
trades.quote: One could attempt to front-run a reclaim of 518-532 from 485-499 if it continues to hold (today’s afternoon pullback low was there) but this is a tight space to navigate so I’ll rate it a C+B-

trades.name: Trapped below 23518-23532, front-run loss of 23485-23499
trades.quote: Trapped below 518-532 has (again) potential to trigger some weakness so trying to front run a loss of 485-499 is not completely unreasonable if sellers defend. Like the above it is a tight space to navigate. I’ll rate it slightly higher and just call it a B- because of the potential for a deeper liquidation through Friday’s thin structure.

trades.name: Trapped below 23485-23499
